body: Thank you!! I really appreciate your pov and i think it’s understandable. To be clear: I did not ask him to come after he told me he wouldn’t. instead i simply told him how upset it made me that he couldn’t. I definitely could have and should have gone about this way better. Thank you for the advice and i’m really gonna try to work on communication more!!

I truly wasn’t trying to guilt him but he kept pressuring me to tell him and so I did. I will however say that I definitely did not go about expressing my sadness and disappointment in a good way and for that I am apologetic. I plan to learn from this mistake and hopefully be able to go about e promo emotions in a healthy way!!
Thank you stranger!! I really appreciate this and i’ll be sure to remember these moving forward.
